_meta.usage: nine-digit number as written on signs: 71 123 45 67, (66) 233-45-67 or +998 65 221 23 45; or only the two-digit code: 66
_meta.note: Since 2018–2020 all numbers have nine digits: a two-digit code, then seven digits; there is no trunk prefix. Geographic codes are 61–79; 20, 33, 50, 77, 80, 87–99 are mobile or other non-geographic ranges.
_meta.miss_note: not a geographic Uzbek code: a mobile number (20, 33, 50, 77, 88, 90–99 …), 78 (non-geographic fixed), 55 (VoIP), an old seven-digit local number written without the code, or a number of another country
source: https://www.goldenpages.uz/uzcodes/ (codes by settlement and district, 2026; 70 Tashkent Region, 36 Navoiy Region)

99836.note: goldenpages.uz lists 36 for most of Navoiy Region (79 only for Gazgan); en.wikipedia lists 79

99870.note: goldenpages.uz lists 70 for Tashkent Region landlines; en.wikipedia lists 70 as Uzmobile mobile, so a 70 number may also be a mobile phone (any region)

99871.note: the Tashkent city zone also serves numbers in parts of Tashkent Region; most of the region is listed under 70

99879.note: en.wikipedia lists 79 for Navoiy Region; goldenpages.uz lists 36 for most of it
